title: dactylorhiza ruthei subsp. osiliensis
intro: Dactylorhiza ruthei subsp. osiliensis, commonly known as the Osili Spotted Orchid, is a species of orchid in the Dactylorhiza genus, known for its distinctive spotted leaves and vibrant purple flowers. This plant is traditionally used in Eastern European folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza ruthei subsp. osiliensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing swelling, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
